decisions.title: Israeli refereeing team named for FCSB's Conference League qualifier
decisions.reason: The match context (FCSB v FK Auda, second qualifying round, Thursday July 23, 20:45, Ghencea/Steaua stadium, Bucharest) is confirmed by UEFA.com and two independent Romanian outlets. However, the story's central claim — the specific Israeli referee appointment (David Foksman and his assistant/fourth-official team) — comes from the single source article and could not be corroborated against a second independent outlet (e.g. UEFA's official referee list or a referee-tracking site) within the research budget. The source article also stated the match would be played 'in Norway,' which directly contradicts the venue confirmed by UEFA and multiple Romanian outlets (Bucharest); that detail has been omitted as unreliable. Given the single-source referee names and this unresolved discrepancy, confidence is capped below the publishable threshold for a firm appointment story pending independent confirmation.

decisions.title: Without Messi, Argentina Comes Home to a Hero's Welcome After World Cup Heartbreak
Butterflies and a 12-year wait: Hapoel Tel Aviv lands in Hungary for Europe's return

The direct player quotes about nerves/focus and the specific injury list (Kurin, Benyamini) come only from the source article and could not be independently corroborated within the research budget; transliteration of 'Roy Kurin' is uncertain (one soccerway record spells it 'Korine').

decisions.title: Kangwa set to start as champions Beer Sheva open Champions League bid in Reykjavik
decisions.reason: The source article described Kangwa's expected defensive-line role and pairing in a way that could not be independently verified; two independent registries (Wikipedia, match-preview lineups) confirm him as a midfielder, so the article describes his role that way rather than repeating an unverifiable back-line pairing. The coach's name transliteration (Kozuch/Kuziak) also varies between the Hebrew source and English coverage and could not be pinned down with full certainty.

decisions.title: Champions Priced as Underdogs: Bookmakers See No Favorite as Beer Sheva Open Europe in Iceland
decisions.reason: The head coach's name is transliterated inconsistently across English-language sources (Kojok/Kozuch/Kozuk for the same Hebrew רן קוז'וך); we use 'Kozuch' per the English text of his Wikipedia entry. Kickoff time carries a minor cross-source discrepancy (the source article gives 22:00 Israel time / 19:00 UTC, while one English preview lists an 8pm local start), so the exact clock time is omitted from the body. The betting odds and prop-bet prices come from a single bookmaker (Winner) as reported in the source and are a snapshot that can move before kickoff; reported figures for any Kangwa transfer fee vary by outlet and were therefore not stated as a specific number.
